measurement_basis: Authenticated Control claim-acquisition outcomes, bounded Environment claim pages, and read-only session/claim inspection. The claim ledger is Store state; the record preserves the exact identities and values observed at capture time.
not_measured: whether the reported matching process belongs to an agent, a stale process, or a Control terminal request
whether other clients automatically follow claim-page cursors
whether the current claim-page byte cap is reached by every workspace
whether the active claim will be released after the owner's current work completes
whether the denied claim altered any branch, file, or Store record

observation.source_interface: MNCS Control project-scoped terminal and MNCS Environment claims/inspect

exact_conflicting_claim.claim_reason: Keep bounded environmental-capability projections within their documented transport byte limit after CLI JSON serialization.

outcome.interpretation: The requested files were already owned by a live same-repository claim. Following the bounded claim cursor identified the owner and matching work. Control refused transfer because its host-side liveness check still reported one matching process. This is an ownership conflict and a discoverability issue, not a request for fresh user approval; no source changes were made to the claimed files.

pressure_hypothesis.title: A claim conflict requires additional pagination to discover its owner and active work
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Environment claim query and Control conflict diagnostics
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The first bounded claims response returned 41 of 112 latest records and provided next_offset=41. The exact claim blocking a path request appeared only on the following page, while the acquisition refusal exposed a process count but not the claim identity or scope. A subsequent exact-page read verified the match.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Make the exact conflicting claim identity, scope, owner freshness, and safe next action discoverable in the refusal response or a path-filtered conflict query. Keep ownership checks authoritative and preserve the response byte bound.
not_measured: whether the first page's ordering consistently omits active claims
whether the process-liveness refusal can be attributed to the former owner
whether the response shape prevented other agents from recovering work

related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS environmental capability intelligence and agent support, including machine-native adoption and capability accountability.
